children: Equity Bancshares received all required regulatory approvals and Lincoln shareholders approved the merger, which is expected to close December 1, 2026.
Lincoln shareholders voted to approve the transaction at a special meeting on November 19, 2026.
The merger is expected to become effective December 1, subject to customary closing conditions being satisfied or waived.
Lincoln shareholders have been mailed election materials; completed forms and required materials are due by 5:00 p.m. Central Time on November 27.
